functionalRepair.reason: Restore the missing dashboard cover component using an on-demand import, refresh the dashboard date, and sort asynchronously enriched Mikan scores. The card now participates in the shared chunk graph. These limits include small explicit rounding headroom; forbidden-module checks remain unchanged. Home/login closures exclude the on-demand card and are not full cold-card network totals.

The gzip increase is an explicit cost of the lifecycle/queue behavior and is measured separately from the historical functional-repair baseline.

syncAndScrollOptimization.reason: The v3.2.32 upstream synchronization adds cover-click actions, torrent fallback handling, the WebFilter/static-cache repair, manifest credentials, and subscription pagination, sorting, filter, scroll, and refresh lifecycle safeguards. The Vite 8.3.0 toolchain also changes shared chunk compression. GitHub Actions Ubuntu build-test 35124151832 measured the closures below; limits retain narrow explicit headroom and forbidden-module checks remain unchanged.

budgetChange.reason: The R01/R02 lifecycle repair changes async route module hash references in the shared entry chunk. The measured latest-fork comparison is limited to home JS +1, home CSS +1, and subscriptions JS +1 gzip byte; static entry and login remain unchanged. No player, Markdown, or backup module enters these closures. GitHub Actions Ubuntu build-test 34077134774 measured static entry JS at 105201 gzip bytes while the local Windows build measured 105194; no closure or forbidden-module change was observed, so the gate is raised by exactly the cross-platform +2-byte observation rather than updated automatically.
